verdict.rationale: Community reports show Solid's site has an interactive playground widget on the landing page and runnable in-browser examples such as CSS animations and todo (solid-comm-3, solid-comm-6). Those same reports describe rendering glitches and examples failing to load on Android Chrome. Nothing in the pack documents an actual API reference with embedded runnable examples. missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference, runnable examples tied to individual API entries, first-party documentation of the playground, reliable cross-device operation of examples
